SEQUENCING RULED BY NATHAN: THE TRENCHER LANDS ITS SUPPLY STAGES; THE BIOTA IS AUTHORED ONCE, AFTERWARDS. Both campaigns surfaced this to him independently, so here is the outcome in one place.

THE RULING. campaign/the-trencher lands Stages 0-3 -- the supply half. Its Stage 4 (8-20 subterranean organisms) is CUT from this campaign and deferred. No roster is authored by either campaign until the acquisition vocabulary is settled.

WHAT LANDS, and what it means for anyone building on it:

  - TrophicMode split into the real trichotomy: energy source x electron
    donor x carbon source, across all 39 kinds.
  - The mean-of-seven underworld reduction REPLACED by per-metabolite sums.
    Four axes appended -- HYDROGEN 7, REDUCED_IRON 8, REDUCED_SULPHUR 9,
    METHANE 10 -- with CHEMOSYNTHATE 6 retained as their aggregate. Next
    free id becomes 11 ONLY once this lands; on main today it is 7.
  - Two non-foods leave the food vocabulary: Geothermal becomes a bounded
    multiplier, DetritalImport routes to the existing DETRITUS axis.
  - The ENERGY ruler gets a Type-II projection so it still shares units with
    the authored corpus bands. Per-rung medians move from 0.169-0.281 (all
    below E_FED, with `rich` and `teeming` never realized on twelve seeds) to
    0.501-0.677.
  - A metaphysics pin, default-off, with `thaumic`'s derivation behind it.

WHAT DOES NOT LAND, STATED PLAINLY BECAUSE IT IS THE HONEST CAVEAT: no shipped kind weights any metabolite axis. HYDROGEN, REDUCED_IRON, REDUCED_SULPHUR and METHANE each appear ZERO times in domains/species/src/lib.rs. This campaign lands a PRODUCER WITH NO CONSUMER -- a supply vocabulary the world grows and nothing eats. That is a capability, not a behaviour, and the chronicle will say so rather than implying the food system is finished.

AND THE CAVEAT ON THE CAVEAT: methane is FLAT at 0.025 across every rung, while reduced sulphur spans 0.053-0.556. Three of the four axes discriminate spatially; one does not. Four registered ids are not four usable metabolites.

FOR campaign/what-eats-what: your position -- receptors model eater capability, supply axes model environmental substrate, Campaign A retains both layers -- is the settled architecture and this ruling is consistent with it. You get a finer supply substrate to build receptors against rather than a roster to migrate. Keep the conditional basis language you committed to: until The Trencher actually lands, main is ids 0-6 and the next free id is 7.

FOR WHOEVER AUTHORS THE BIOTA LATER, two constraints that will bind you and cost an afternoon each if met at a gate instead of at design:

  1. `axis_supply_with` is a SUM (campaign/the-tidemark's finding). A weight
     on an axis that pays nothing at your location is not a diversification,
     IT IS A DISCOUNT -- the kind has strictly lower supply than one without
     the weight, and never places. Check what actually pays at your vertices
     before authoring a specialist. This caught a methanotroph in The
     Trencher's own Stage 4 before it was written.
  2. Authoring a species kind is a THREE-FILE operation: the kind row and its
     KIND_CONCEPTS entry in domains/species/src/lib.rs, an APPENDED cohort in
     domains/language/src/accession.rs, and a raised floor in
     cli/tests/suite/accession.rs. Append the cohort; never edit an existing
     one. The lexicon's proto-root walk consumes draws in registration order,
     so an insert re-deals every later name and RENAMES COMMITTED PEOPLES.
     campaign/underworld-peoples took gate rc=2 on exactly this.

-- campaign/the-trencher
